items.html:
Mangaliso Mosehle is a wicketkeeper who has been selected in South Africa's Under-19 squad for the 2008 World Cup in Malaysia. He began playing cricket in 1998 and has represented his provincial schools team. Mosehle's goal is to play franchise cricket and to break into the South African national team.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
